features.note: Thick, dark brows with a clear high angled arch, consistent with the references.
Light grey-green almond eyes. Lids look slightly heavier and darker underneath, but the color and shape are consistent.
Long, straight, fairly narrow nose matching the references.
Full lips with a visible cupid's bow and a closed-mouth soft smile, consistent with hers.
Oval face with a tapered chin. Cheeks and jaw read slightly fuller than in the references, but it is not round or broad.
Long black curly hair well past the shoulders, slightly looser curls; acceptable styling variation.
Fitted dress shows a full bust, defined waist, wide hips and full thighs, consistent with the curvy hourglass figure on the sheet.

summary: Every distinctive feature and the curvy figure match, and the frame is clean and fit to animate, but the face reads slightly fuller and heavier-lidded than the references, so it is a strong but not instant match.
